JUSTICE MANJULA CHELLUR, CHAIRPERSON ** In this Appeal, the conditions of EC, facts and circumstances are similar to that of Appeal No. 21 of 2019 (Talwandi Sabo Power Limited Vs. Punjab State Electricity Regulatory Commission & Anr.) and Appeal No. 73 of 2019 (Nabha Power Limited Vs. Punjab State Electricity Regulatory Commission & Anr.). Therefore, the instant Appeal is disposed of in terms of the Judgment in Appeal Nos. 21 & 73 of 2019 dated 28.08.2020 upholding the impugned order passed by Respondent No.1-MERC. **2.** Registry is directed to keep a copy of the Judgment in Appeal Nos. 21 of 2019 & 73 of 2019 in the instant Appeal also along with this order. **3.** No order as to costs. **4.** Pending IAs, if any shall stand disposed of. **5.** Pronounced in the Virtual Court on this **, the 28** **th** **day of August** ## **2020.** **(S.D.
